body.zh: 感染控制面向消毒湿巾、干巾与皮肤除菌，清洁护理覆盖化妆品、个人护理与清洁，工业擦拭服务强力去污与洁净室擦拭，定制开发提供产品开发与品牌代工。四条产品线共享稳定基材、可靠包装和批次追溯体系。
body.en: INFECTION CONTROL covers disinfectant wipes, dry wipes, and antiseptic skin wipes; CLEANSING & CARE supports cosmetic, personal-care, and cleansing needs; INDUSTRIAL WIPING serves heavy-duty cleaning and cleanroom wiping; and OEM/ODM delivers custom products and private-label manufacturing. All four lines share stable substrates, reliable packaging, and batch traceability.

skus.title: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Bathing Wipes
skus.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾包装正反面

body.zh: 8片式免冲洗全身沐浴湿巾，兼顾清洁、保湿和床旁护理效率。
body.en: An 8-wipe no-rinse full-body bathing system for cleansing, moisturizing, and efficient bedside care.

intro.zh: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾将身体清洁与皮肤保湿整合到一包 8 片的床旁沐浴方案，适合卧床、术后、老年护理、长期照护和旅行应急清洁。
intro.en: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Bathing Wipes combine body cleansing and skin moisturizing in one 8-wipe bedside bathing system for bedridden, post-operative, elderly-care, long-term-care, travel, and emergency cleansing scenarios.

gallery.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾包装正反面
VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾使用场景
VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾清洁护理细节

highlights.zh: 100gsm 超厚无纺布与 20 x 30 cm 大尺寸设计，覆盖面积更大，适合全身清洁护理。
highlights.en: 100gsm ultra-thick nonwoven and a 20 x 30 cm oversized sheet give broader coverage for full-body care.

highlights.zh: 每包 8 片，对应身体 8 个部位，帮助护理流程更卫生、更规范。
highlights.en: Each 8-wipe pack maps to eight body zones, helping care teams follow a cleaner and more standardized routine.

highlights.zh: 免冲洗护理液可减少用水、脸盆和毛巾依赖，并支持微波加热提升舒适度。
highlights.en: The no-rinse lotion reduces reliance on water, basins, and towels, with microwave warming support for comfort.

usage.zh: 打开包装，每次取出一片湿巾；如需温热体验，可将整包在低于 750W 的微波炉中加热不超过 15 秒，并在使用前测试温度。
usage.en: Open the pack and remove one wipe at a time. For a warm bathing experience, microwave the whole pack below 750W for no more than 15 seconds and test wipe temperature before use.

usage.zh: 建议按 8 片式顺序清洁颈部与躯干、背部、左右手臂与腋下、臀部、腹股沟、左右腿足；每片湿巾用于一个身体部位。
usage.en: Use the 8-wipe sequence across neck and torso, back, left and right arm with axilla, buttocks, groin, and left and right leg with foot; use one wipe per body area.

usage.zh: 使用后无需冲洗；用过的湿巾请丢弃且不要冲入马桶，开封后请重新密封以保持湿润。
usage.en: No rinsing is required. Dispose of used wipes and do not flush; reseal the pack after opening to retain moisture.

value.zh: 可微波加热，低于 750W 且不超过 15 秒
value.en: Microwavable below 750W for no more than 15 seconds

skus.title: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Bathing Gloves
skus.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴手套包装

body.zh: 8片式免冲洗沐浴手套，贴合手部，更适合床旁全身清洁护理。
body.en: An 8-glove no-rinse bathing system that fits the hand for full-body bedside cleansing.

intro.zh: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴手套将免冲洗清洁护理液与手套式布料结合，便于护理人员在床旁完成更可控、更体面的全身清洁流程。
intro.en: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Bathing Gloves combine a no-rinse cleansing lotion with a glove format, helping caregivers perform controlled and dignified bedside full-body cleansing.

gallery.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴手套包装
VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴手套使用细节

highlights.zh: 80gsm 超厚多层无纺布，柔软亲肤、厚实耐用，吸液性更佳。
highlights.en: 80gsm ultra-thick multilayer nonwoven is soft, durable, and highly absorbent.

highlights.zh: 手套式结构贴合手部，清洁时更易操控和移动，提高床旁沐浴效率。
highlights.en: The glove format fits the hand for easier control and movement during bedside bathing.

highlights.zh: 每包 8 片对应身体 8 个部位，支持更卫生、规范的护理流程。
highlights.en: Each 8-glove pack maps to eight body zones for a cleaner and more standardized care routine.

usage.zh: 打开包装，每次取出一只手套；如需温热体验，可将整包在低于 750W 的微波炉中加热不超过 15 秒，并在使用前测试温度。
usage.en: Open the pack and remove one glove at a time. For warming, microwave the whole pack below 750W for no more than 15 seconds and test temperature before use.

usage.zh: 建议按 8 片式沐浴顺序清洁不同身体部位；每只手套用于一个身体部位。
usage.en: Use the 8-piece bathing sequence across different body zones; use one glove per body area.

usage.zh: 使用后无需冲洗；用过的手套请丢弃且不要冲入马桶，开封后请重新密封以保持湿润。
usage.en: No rinsing is required. Dispose of used gloves and do not flush; reseal after opening to retain moisture.

value.zh: 可微波加热，低于 750W 且不超过 15 秒
value.en: Microwavable below 750W for no more than 15 seconds

skus.title: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Shampoo Cap

body.zh: 免冲洗洗发浴帽，帮助床旁洗发更体面、更轻松。
body.en: A no-rinse shampoo cap that makes bedside hair cleansing easier and more dignified.

intro.zh: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗洗发浴帽适用于传统洗头不便的护理场景，可在卧姿或坐姿下完成头发与头皮清洁，减少取水、脸盆、毛巾和现场清理。
intro.en: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Shampoo Cap supports hair and scalp cleansing when traditional washing is difficult, reducing water, basins, towels, and clean-up during bedside care.

gallery.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗洗发浴帽包装正反面
VINNERLOVE 免冲洗洗发浴帽使用方式
VINNERLOVE 免冲洗洗发浴帽产品细节

highlights.zh: 85gsm 超厚多层无纺布，柔软舒适且厚实耐用，适合头发与头皮清洁护理。
highlights.en: 85gsm ultra-thick multilayer nonwoven is soft, comfortable, and durable for hair and scalp cleansing.

highlights.zh: 充分浸润清洁液，帮助湿润头发与头皮，使清洁过程更充分、舒适。
highlights.en: Richly loaded cleansing lotion helps wet hair and scalp for a more comfortable cleansing process.

highlights.zh: 开包即用，使用后直接丢弃，简化床旁洗发流程并减少共用器具风险。
highlights.en: Ready to use and disposable after use, simplifying bedside shampooing and reducing shared-tool risk.

usage.zh: 打开包装，取出一个浴帽；如需温热体验，未开封产品可用不超过 550W 的微波炉加热不超过 15 秒。
usage.en: Open the pack and remove one cap. For warmth, microwave the unopened product at no more than 550W for no more than 15 seconds.

usage.zh: 将浴帽戴在头上，轻轻揉搓头发和头皮，直至清洁完成。
usage.en: Place the cap on the head and gently massage hair and scalp until cleansing is complete.

usage.zh: 无需冲洗；如有需要可用毛巾擦干，使用后请妥善丢弃。
usage.en: No rinsing is required. Towel dry if needed and dispose of the used cap properly.

value.zh: 可微波加热，低于 550W 且不超过 15 秒
value.en: Microwavable below 550W for no more than 15 seconds

value.zh: 免冲洗头发与头皮清洁护理
value.en: No-rinse hair and scalp cleansing care

skus.title: VINNERLOVE Continence Care Wipes
skus.alt: VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾包装正反面

body.zh: 4合1乳霜护理湿巾，一步完成清洁、保湿、舒缓和屏障防护。
body.en: A 4-in-1 cream care wipe for cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and barrier protection in one step.

intro.zh: VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾适用于失禁护理、脆弱老年肌肤、皮肤褶皱、MASD 易感肌和压疮风险护理，通过一个简单步骤提供清洁、保湿、舒缓和屏障防护。
intro.en: VINNERLOVE Continence Care Wipes support incontinence care, fragile elderly skin, skin folds, MASD-prone skin, and pressure-injury risk care with cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and barrier protection in one step.

gallery.alt: VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾包装正反面
VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾产品细节
VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾护理场景

highlights.zh: 4合1护理逻辑：清洁、保湿、舒缓、屏障防护，减少传统多步骤护理复杂度。
highlights.en: A 4-in-1 care logic combines cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and barrier protection to simplify multi-step care.

highlights.zh: 金黄洋甘菊提取物、金缕梅提取物与屏障体系，帮助舒缓脆弱及潮湿暴露皮肤。
highlights.en: Chamomile extract, witch hazel extract, and a barrier system help soothe fragile and moisture-exposed skin.

highlights.zh: 含 4% 二甲基硅油和 6% 液体石蜡，在皮肤表面形成透气防护层。
highlights.en: 4% dimethicone and 6% liquid paraffin form a breathable protective barrier on skin.

usage.zh: 打开包装，取出一片湿巾，轻柔清洁受影响或潮湿暴露的皮肤区域。
usage.en: Open the pack and remove one wipe, then gently cleanse affected or moisture-exposed skin.

usage.zh: 必要时让皮肤自然干燥，无需冲洗；每个身体部位建议使用新的湿巾。
usage.en: Allow skin to air dry if needed. No rinsing is required; use a fresh wipe for each body area.

usage.zh: 开封后请重新密封包装，使用后丢弃且不要冲入马桶；若皮肤问题持续或加重，请寻求专业医护评估。
usage.en: Reseal after opening. Dispose after use and do not flush; seek professional care if skin issues persist or worsen.

value.zh: 含乳霜配方的 4合1 皮肤护理湿巾
value.en: 4-in-1 skin care wipe with cream formula

value.zh: 4% 二甲基硅油 + 6% 液体石蜡
pH 平衡，经皮肤科测试

intro.en: HOMEKEEP Pure Water Wipes use 99%+ purified water, 100% plant-based fibers, and a minimal formula for babies, sensitive skin, elderly users, and gentle daily family care.

gallery.alt: HOMEKEEP 纯水婴儿湿巾包装
HOMEKEEP 纯水婴儿湿巾产品细节

highlights.en: 99%+ purified water formula keeps only necessary ingredients to reduce unnecessary irritation.

highlights.en: 100% plant-based fibers with no plastic-based fibers, soft and skin-friendly.
